name: When should a real estate broker consider investing in AEO services?

mainEntity.name: When should a real estate broker consider investing in AEO services?

acceptedAnswer.text: A real estate broker should consider AEO services when they notice a decline in direct traffic from search engines, or if they want to capitalize on the growing trend of voice search and AI-powered answers. It's particularly beneficial if your target audience frequently uses digital assistants or asks specific questions about local markets, property types, or the home-buying process. Early adoption can provide a significant competitive advantage in capturing qualified leads.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider AEO when direct search traffic declines, or to leverage voice search and AI answers, especially if your audience asks specific market questions.
